verdict.rationale: Claude is a general-purpose AI assistant and coding agent, not equity-management or cap-table software. Producing audit-ready ASC 718 stock-based compensation expense reports is a category-specific compliance capability outside this product type's axis. The evidence only shows generic file creation, code execution, and docs features, with no first-party ASC 718 reporting capability.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can produce ASC 718 stock-based compensation expense reports my accountants can hand to auditors
